home.title: Home
home.settings_body: Name, contact details, currency, shipping, payments and legal pages.
home.products_body: Add products, photos, sizes, colors and stock.

kpis.cod_to_collect_hint: Cash on delivery not yet collected

chart.title: Sales
chart.empty: No sales in this period yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Everything about your store that changes without a code deploy.
settings.read_only: You can view these settings but not change them.
settings.invalid: This value isn't valid. Check the format and try again.
settings.long_text_hint: Plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Start a line with ## for a heading, or with - for a list item.

site_name.label: Store name
site_name.description: Shown in the header, page titles, emails and the dashboard.

site_description.label: Store description
site_description.description: Short tagline used by search engines and link previews.

site_logo_url.label: Logo
site_logo_url.description: Image shown in the header instead of the store name. Leave empty to use the name.

site_favicon_url.label: Favicon
site_favicon_url.description: Browser tab icon. Square PNG, JPG or SVG.

maintenance_mode.label: Maintenance notice
maintenance_mode.description: Shows a notice at the top of every page.

site_contact.label: Contact details
site_contact.description: Shown on the contact page and in the footer.

store_address.label: Store address
store_address.description: Your business address, shown on the contact page and legal pages.

social_links.label: Social links
social_links.description: Full profile URLs. Empty links are hidden.

currency.label: Currency
currency.description: The currency your prices are set and charged in.

default_locale.label: Default language
default_locale.description: Used when a visitor's browser language isn't supported.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.description: Used for order dates and reports.

shipping_rates.label: Shipping rates
shipping_rates.description: The methods customers choose at checkout. Countries in a shipping zone below get that zone's rates instead.

free_shipping_threshold.label: Free shipping from
free_shipping_threshold.description: Order subtotal from which shipping is free. 0 turns it off.

tax_rate.label: Tax rate (%)
tax_rate.description: Percentage applied at checkout, for example 22.

tax_included.label: Prices include tax
tax_included.description: On: product prices already include tax. Off: tax is added at checkout.

privacy_policy.label: Privacy policy
privacy_policy.description: The text of the Privacy policy page.

terms_and_conditions.label: Terms and conditions
terms_and_conditions.description: The text of the Terms and conditions page.

returns_days.label: Return window (days)
returns_days.description: Shown on product pages and the home page. 0 hides it.

primary_domain_store.label: Primary store domain
primary_domain_store.description: Every other store address redirects here. Set it from Settings → Domains.

primary_domain_admin.label: Primary admin domain
primary_domain_admin.description: Every other admin address redirects here. Set it from Settings → Domains.

navigation.label: Navigation
navigation.description: Header menu and footer, edited in Online store → Themes → Customize → Navigation.

low_stock_threshold.label: Low stock threshold
low_stock_threshold.description: Variants at or below this stock show as low stock.

shipping_zones.label: Shipping zones
shipping_zones.description: Countries with their own rates and tax. Customers anywhere else get the rates above.

ship_only_to_zones.label: Only ship to these zones
ship_only_to_zones.description: On: customers outside every zone can't order (the checkout says so).

shipping_zones.empty: No zones yet: every country gets the rates above.
shipping_zones.name: Name
shipping_zones.tax_hint: Empty = the default tax rate (Settings → Taxes).

reviews.edit: Approve, hide, reply to and delete reviews

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Each role grants a set of permissions. Members can have several roles.
roles.name: Name
roles.delete_body: A role still assigned to members can't be deleted.
roles.full_access_hint: Grants every permission. Only admins can assign it.

activity.title: Activity
activity.subtitle: Who did what in the admin, including refused attempts.

actions.activate_or_deactivate_a_team_member: Activated or deactivated a team member
actions.create_a_role_with_full_access: Created a role with full access
actions.delete_a_role_with_full_access: Deleted a role with full access
actions.edit_a_role_with_full_access: Edited a role with full access
actions.invite_a_team_member_with_admin_access: Invited a team member with admin access
actions.clear_the_primary_domain: Stopped redirecting to the primary domain
actions.complete_a_draft_order: Turned a draft into an order
actions.search_products_for_a_draft_order: Searched products for a draft order
actions.search_customers_for_a_draft_order: Searched customers for a draft order

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Who can sign in to the admin and what they can do.
staff.name: Name

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Group products so customers can browse the store.
categories.delete_body: This can't be undone. Categories with products or subcategories can't be deleted.

form.name: Name
form.image_after_create: Save the category first to add an image.

products.title: Products
products.search_placeholder: Search by title, handle or tag
products.empty: No products yet. Add your first product to start selling.
products.bulk_delete_body: They disappear from the store and the dashboard. Past orders keep their copies.
products.move_hint: Choose a category for the selected products.

editor.created: Product created. Now add images and variants.
editor.delete_body: It disappears from the store and the dashboard. Past orders keep their copy.
editor.title: Title
editor.description_hint: Plain text. Separate paragraphs with a blank line.
editor.compare_at_hint: Original price shown crossed out. Leave 0 for none.
editor.status_hint: Only active products are visible in the store.
editor.media_hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB each. The first image is the main one.
editor.after_create: Save the product first to add images and variants.
editor.gift_card_hint: Paying for it issues a gift card worth the price (one per unit) and emails the code. Use variants for the amounts.

variants.hint: Each combination of size and color is a variant with its own stock and SKU.
variants.sizes_hint: Separate with commas, e.g. XS, S, M, L, XL
variants.empty: No variants yet. Generate them from sizes and colors, or add one.

import.title: Import from CSV
import.subtitle: Add or update many products or categories at once from a spreadsheet.
import.file_hint_products: One row per variant (size/color). Rows with the same handle are one product. Missing categories are created.
import.file_hint_categories: One row per category. Use the parent column to put a category inside another one.
import.choose_file: Click to choose a CSV file
import.choose_file_hint: UTF-8 CSV, comma separated, up to 100 MB
import.file_too_large: This file is larger than 100 MB. Split it into smaller files.

problems_title.one: {count} problem found. These products or categories will be skipped:
problems_title.other: {count} problems found. These products or categories will be skipped:

problems.invalid_handle: invalid handle (use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens)
problems.missing_title: a title is needed in at least one language
problems.invalid_compare_at: the compare-at price must be higher than the price
problems.invalid_status: status must be draft, active or archived
problems.duplicate_sku: SKU used twice in the file
problems.invalid_stock: stock must be a whole number

import.update_existing_hint: Items whose handle already exists are updated. Turn off to skip them.
import.download_images_hint: Images are copied from the image_urls links, only for products without images. Slower; turn off to import text and prices first.
import.keep_open: Keep this page open until the import finishes.

missing_images.one: {count} product was imported but some images couldn't be downloaded.
missing_images.other: {count} products were imported but some images couldn't be downloaded.

reasons.sku_taken: a SKU belongs to another product

orders_admin.title: Orders
orders_admin.empty: No orders yet. They will appear here as soon as customers check out.

detail.cancel_body: The customer will see this order as cancelled. This can't be undone.
detail.restock: Put the items back in stock
detail.fulfill_body: Add the carrier and tracking number so the customer can follow the shipment.

messages.title: Messages
messages.select: Select a message to read it.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Everyone who has an account or has placed an order.
customers.search_placeholder: Search by name, email or phone
customers.empty: No customers yet. They appear here when someone signs up or places an order.
customers.no_orders: This customer hasn't placed an order yet.
customers.note_placeholder: Add a note about this customer…
customers.marketing_hint: Whether the customer agreed to receive marketing emails.

index_table.select_all: Select all rows on this page
index_table.no_results_body: Try changing the filters or the search.

save_bar.leave_warning: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page anyway?

seo.card_hint: How this can appear in Google and when shared. Empty fields use the title and description.
seo.title: Page title
seo.title_hint: Up to about {max} characters show in search results.
seo.description_hint: One or two sentences that make people click.

admin_shell.login_subtitle: Sign in to manage your store.

domains.title: Domains
domains.subtitle: Connect your own domain and choose where customers and staff land.
domains.primary_hint: Every other address of this app redirects to {domain}.
domains.no_primary: No primary domain: every address of this app works on its own.

status_hints.pending: Add the DNS records below at your domain registrar. Changes can take from a few minutes to 48 hours.
status_hints.verifying: DNS looks right. The host is verifying the domain and issuing the SSL certificate.
status_hints.error: Something went wrong at the hosting provider.

domains.records_hint: Create these at the company where you bought the domain (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Cloudflare, Aruba…).
domains.records_none: No records to show yet. In manual mode, set HOSTING_STORE_TARGET_HOST / HOSTING_ADMIN_TARGET_HOST so the records can be listed.
domains.add_body: Use a domain or subdomain you own, like shop.example.com. You'll get the DNS records to create next.
domains.added: Domain added. Now create its DNS records.
domains.primary_set: Primary domain updated. Redirects start within a minute.
domains.remove_body: It is disconnected from the hosting provider and stops working for this store.

setup.railway: Connected to Railway: domains are attached to your services automatically.
setup.vercel: Connected to Vercel: domains are attached to your projects automatically.
setup.manual: Manual setup: also add each domain in your hosting provider's dashboard. Set HOSTING_PROVIDER (railway or vercel) and a token to do it from here.
setup.missing: HOSTING_PROVIDER is {provider}, but these variables are missing: {names}. Using manual setup until they're set.

domains.url_reminder: After changing the primary domain, update NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_URL and redeploy, so links and emails use it.

themes.title: Themes
themes.subtitle: Choose how your store looks. Customize a theme, then publish it when it's ready.
themes.library_hint: Themes you've added. Customize them and publish one when it's ready.
themes.library_empty: No other themes yet. Add a template from the gallery below.
themes.gallery_hint: Start from a design and make it yours. Adding a template doesn't change your store until you publish it.
themes.publish_body: It replaces the current theme on your store right away. You can publish the old one again at any time.
themes.published_slow: {name} is now live. Store pages update within a minute.
themes.delete_body: The theme and its versions are deleted. Your store isn't affected.

templates.atelier: Editorial and calm: serif headings, soft neutrals, the logo next to the menu.
templates.minimal: Lots of white space, one clean typeface, square corners and outlined buttons.
templates.bold: Streetwear energy: condensed capitals, a strong accent colour and a dark header.
templates.classic: Warm boutique look: an elegant serif, cream tones, a centred logo and framed products.

editor.discard_body: The editor goes back to the version that's published for this theme. This can't be undone.
editor.history_hint: Restoring puts a version in the editor. Publish to make it live.
editor.restored: Version restored. Publish to make it live.
editor.max_sections: A home page can have up to {count} sections.
editor.preview_off_body: Set THEME_PREVIEW_SECRET (any random text of at least 16 characters) in both apps' environment and restart them. Your changes are still saved.

fields.heading: Heading
fields.subtitle: Subtitle
fields.image_hint: A link to an image (https://…) or a path on your store, like /images/hero.jpg.
fields.button_hint: A page of your store (/shop, /about) or a full address. Leave the label empty to hide the button.
fields.categories_hint: None selected: the first top-level categories.
fields.body_hint: Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Lines starting with “- ” become a list.
fields.no_settings: This section is built from your store settings (shipping, returns and payment methods).
fields.question: Question
fields.caption: Caption
fields.video_hint: A YouTube or Vimeo link, or the address of a video file (mp4, webm).
fields.show_details: Show contact details next to the form
fields.show_details_hint: Email, phone and address from Settings → General.
fields.product_main_hint: Photos, price, sizes and the add-to-cart button. Move it, and add sections above or below it.
fields.show_assurances: Show delivery, returns and payment reassurances

settings.contrast_warning: Text may be hard to read on this background (contrast {ratio}:1, aim for at least 4.5:1).
settings.utility_bar_hint: Shows the phone and email from Settings → General.
settings.announcement_hint: Leave it empty to show the free-shipping message (when free shipping is on).
settings.logo_hint: The logo and favicon are in Settings → General.

editor.custom_page_hint: Pages are saved as you type and aren't part of the theme. Publish or hide them in Online store → Pages.

navigation.live_hint: Menus are saved as you type and are live right away, for every theme.
navigation.header_automatic: No menu yet: the store shows “Shop all” and your top categories.
navigation.add_sublink: Add a link to the submenu
navigation.link_hint: Start typing to pick a page or category, or paste a full address.
navigation.footer_about_hint: Leave it empty to use the store description from Settings → General.
navigation.footer_automatic: No columns yet: the footer shows a Shop and a Help column.

media.library_body: Pick an image you've uploaded before. JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 10 MB.

custom_pages.title: Pages
custom_pages.subtitle: Extra pages for your store, like a size guide or a lookbook, built from the same sections as your theme.
custom_pages.empty_body: Create a page, then build it in the theme editor.
custom_pages.delete_body: The page and its address stop working. Menus that link to it need updating.
custom_pages.created: Page created. Add its content now.
custom_pages.settings_body: Name, address, visibility and search engine text.
custom_pages.add_body: It starts hidden: publish it once its content is ready.
custom_pages.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, like size-guide.
custom_pages.published_hint: Hidden pages can only be seen in the theme editor.
custom_pages.seo_hint: Leave them empty to use the page title.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Choose how customers can pay. They see the enabled methods at checkout, in this order.
payments.methods_hint: Manual methods (bank transfer, pay in store…) place the order as unpaid; you mark it paid when the money arrives.

edit_hint.stripe: The name customers see for card payments.
edit_hint.cash_on_delivery: Customers pay the courier when the order arrives.
edit_hint.manual: Customers pay outside the store, for example by bank transfer.

payments.name: Name at checkout

instructions_hint.cash_on_delivery: Shown at checkout and on the thank-you page.
instructions_hint.manual: Shown at checkout, on the thank-you page and in the confirmation email: bank details, reference to use…

payments.fee_hint: Added to the order total when this method is chosen. 0 = none.

stripe.title: Stripe
stripe.description: Card payments, Apple Pay and Google Pay through Stripe Checkout.
stripe.publishable_hint: Stripe → Developers → API keys. Starts with pk_test_ or pk_live_.
stripe.saved_hint: Saved (encrypted). Type a new one to replace it.
stripe.webhook_steps: In Stripe → Developers → Webhooks, add an endpoint with this address, then paste its signing secret below.
stripe.encryption_missing: To save secret keys here, set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (16+ random characters) in the admin's and the store's environment.

email_sending.title: Email sending
email_sending.subtitle: The mail server your store sends order emails from.
email_sending.server_hint: From your email provider (Gmail, Outlook, your hosting, Brevo, Mailgun…).
email_sending.password_saved: Saved (encrypted). Type a new one to replace it.
email_sending.encryption_missing: To save the password here, set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (16+ random characters) in the admin's and the store's environment.
email_sending.sender_hint: What customers see in their inbox. Use an address your server is allowed to send from.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: The emails your store sends, and when. Edit their text in each language.
notifications.smtp_missing: Emails aren't sent yet: set up the mail server first.
notifications.customer_hint: Switch an email off to stop sending it.
notifications.subject: Subject
notifications.body_hint: Plain text. A blank line starts a new paragraph. Lines with an empty placeholder are left out. Order emails add the items and totals below.
notifications.invalid_emails: One of these isn't a valid email address.
notifications.log_hint: The latest emails the store sent.

order_confirmation.title: Order confirmation
order_confirmation.when: To the customer, when an order is placed.

payment_received.title: Payment received
payment_received.when: To the customer, when an unpaid order is marked paid.

order_shipped.title: Order shipped
order_shipped.when: To the customer, when the order ships (with tracking).

order_delivered.title: Order delivered
order_delivered.when: To the customer, when the order is marked delivered.

order_cancelled.title: Order cancelled
order_cancelled.when: To the customer, when the order is cancelled.

order_refunded.title: Refund
order_refunded.when: To the customer, when the order is refunded.

draft_invoice.title: Draft order invoice
draft_invoice.when: To the customer, from a draft order, with a payment link.

staff_new_order.title: New order (staff)
staff_new_order.when: To the staff addresses below, when an order is placed.

abandoned_checkout.title: Abandoned checkout
abandoned_checkout.when: To the customer, when they left the checkout without ordering.

gift_card.title: Gift card
gift_card.when: To the buyer (or the person you issue it to), with the code.

notifications.abandoned_hint: Remind customers who typed their email at checkout but didn't order.
notifications.abandoned_delay_hint: 0 = only by hand, from Orders → Abandoned checkouts. Automatic sending needs the cron job (see the deploy guide).

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock for every variant. Low stock means {threshold} or fewer (Settings → Store details).
inventory.search_placeholder: Search by product, SKU, size or colour

draft_orders.title: Drafts
draft_orders.search_placeholder: Search by draft number, name or email
draft_orders.empty_body: For phone or in-store orders, wholesale or a custom item: send the customer an invoice to pay online, or mark it paid.
draft_orders.custom_item_hint: An item that isn't in the catalog. It doesn't change stock.
draft_orders.no_lines: No items yet. Search for a product or add a custom item.
draft_orders.not_available: Not available in this quantity any more
draft_orders.language_hint: For the invoice and the order emails.
draft_orders.smtp_missing: Set up email sending first (Settings → Email sending).
draft_orders.save_first: Save your changes before sending the invoice or creating the order.
draft_orders.delete_body: The draft and its invoice link stop working. This can't be undone.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.empty_body: Percentage off, a fixed amount or free shipping, for the whole order or some products, with dates and limits.
discounts.code_hint: Customers type it at checkout. Letters, numbers, - and _.
discounts.internal_title_hint: Only staff see it, e.g. "Summer sale".
discounts.usage_limit: Limit the total number of uses
discounts.dates_hint: Times are in the store's time zone ({zone}).

invalid.ends_at: The end must be after the start.

discounts.delete_body: The code stops working at checkout. Past orders keep their discount. This can't be undone.

abandoned.title: Abandoned checkouts
abandoned.subtitle: Customers who typed their email at checkout at least an hour ago and didn't order.
abandoned.smtp_missing: Reminders can't be sent yet: set up the mail server first.
abandoned.automatic_on: Reminders also go out automatically {hours} h after the email was typed.
abandoned.automatic_off: Reminders are only sent by hand.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.subtitle: Measure visits and ads. Every tag waits for the visitor's cookie consent.
tracking.google_hint: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 and Google Ads.
tracking.meta_hint: The Pixel in the browser plus the Conversions API from the server, with the same event id so Meta counts each event once.

hints.gtm_id: Use either GTM or the Google tag, not both for the same tags.
hints.google_tag_id: A Google Analytics 4 id (G-…) or a Google Ads id (AW-…).
hints.google_ads_conversion: From Google Ads → Goals → Conversions → your purchase action → Tag setup.
hints.meta_pixel_id: From Meta Events Manager → Data sources.

tracking.capi_saved: Saved (encrypted). Type a new one to replace it.
tracking.capi_not_set: Not set: only the browser Pixel is used.
tracking.encryption_missing: To save the token here, set SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (16+ random characters) in the admin's and the store's environment.
tracking.consent_note: Statistics tags load after the visitor accepts statistics cookies; Meta and Google Ads after they accept marketing cookies. Orders keep where the customer came from (UTM and ad click ids).
tracking.invalid: This doesn't look like a valid id.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Sales, orders and customers, compared with the period before.
analytics.period: {from} – {to} ({zone}). Cancelled and refunded orders aren't counted.

refund.title: Refund
refund.amount_hint: Up to {max}. Filled from the items you pick; you can change it.
refund.restock: Put the items back in stock
refund.card_note: Card payment: the amount goes back to the card through Stripe.
refund.manual_note: Not a card payment: give the money back yourself (cash, bank transfer). This only records it.
refund.gift_card_split: {gift_card} goes back onto the gift card that paid for part of this order; {money} is refunded in money.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: Groups of products with their own page: "Summer", "On sale", "Gifts under €50".
collections.empty_body: Pick products by hand, or let rules fill the collection (a tag, a category, on sale, a price).
collections.kind_hint: Automatic collections update by themselves when products change.
collections.no_products: No products yet. Search above to add some.
collections.delete_body: Its store page stops working. The products themselves stay. This can't be undone.

gift_cards.title: Gift cards
gift_cards.subtitle: Sold as products (mark a product as a gift card) or issued here. Customers use them in the discount code field at checkout.
gift_cards.issue_hint: A new code with this value. You can email it to a customer.
gift_cards.search_placeholder: Search by the last characters of the code or email
gift_cards.empty_body: Issue one here, or mark a product as a gift card so customers can buy them.
gift_cards.notify: Email the code to the customer
gift_cards.issued: Gift card issued. Copy the code now, or find it here later.
gift_cards.card_hint: Balance and every time it was used.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: Written by customers who bought the product. A review shows on the product page once you approve it.
reviews.empty_body: Customers can review a product after buying it. New reviews wait here for your approval.
reviews.reply_hint: Shown under the review on the product page. Leave empty for no reply.
reviews.delete_body: The review is removed for good. The customer can then write a new one.

api_keys.title: API keys
api_keys.subtitle: Let an AI assistant such as Claude work with your store. A key acts as the staff member who created it, with the same permissions.
api_keys.connect_body: Add this address as a custom connector (MCP server) in your assistant:
api_keys.connect_header: Send the key in the Authorization header: Bearer <key>. The assistant can then look up orders, products, stock, customers, discounts and sales, update order status and tracking, add notes and adjust stock.
api_keys.create_hint: Give the key a name so you know where it is used.
api_keys.created_hint: Copy the key now. For safety it is shown only once.
api_keys.name: Name
api_keys.revoke_body: Anything using “{name}” stops working right away. This can't be undone.
